what: Descriptive load descriptors of the moderate rung of the 869828 hand bar (cd_ib0_k100, seed 0): median and range over 48 cells (12 gate topologies 19537-19548 x g0-g3). Not a gate, not a verdict; changes no node ruling.

definitions.lat_over_svc: averageElapsedTime / (averageColdStartTime + averageExecutionTime + averageCommunicationsTime); the no-queue service time is exec + cold start + transfer (communications). The headline form.
definitions.lat_over_svc_pull: the same with averagePullTime added to the service time
definitions.lat_over_noqueue: averageElapsedTime / (averageElapsedTime - averageQueueTime - lock_wait.mean), i.e. with all queueing removed

utilisation.status: MEASURED from a rerun of the 48 moderate cells with the raw results kept; every rerun cell reproduces its stored summary exactly (total_rtt, endTime, queue shares: 48/48, 0 mismatches).

rerun.cmd_env: R1A_ARMS=cd_ib0_k100 R1A_TOPOS=19537..19548 WF1_RUNGS=moderate KEEP_RAW_DIR=/share/nikola.lukic/uncut_arm1/ld_raw IN=gate_inputs_arm1/inputs_group SELECT=arm1_selected.json PAR=24 CELL_MEM=12G LIMIT=14400 (r1a_gate.sbatch unchanged; KEEP_RAW_DIR is the gate's own switch, fresh_topo_burst_v1_gate.py)

definition.load_time: accumulates cold_start_duration + task_duration when a task finishes on the platform: compute (cold start + execution) busy time; transfers are not in it
definition.where_at_pin_d6ae87c2: src/placement/infrastructure.py:1946 (self.load_time += cold_start_duration + task_duration), :910 (idle_time = env.now - load_time), :925 (idleProportion); src/placement/orchestrator.py:368 and :373 (averageOccupation = the mean over ALL platforms of 100 - idleProportion; streaming path), :582-585 (the other path)
definition.averageOccupation: mean over all 919 platforms (clients included); client nodes (nodeId 0-159) run nothing under HEROSIM_SERVER_ONLY_REPLICAS, so the server-platform mean is the load descriptor
definition.server_platforms: nodeId 160-183 (the 24 servers; accessClasses order client_node0..159 then node0..23)

platform_count.note: identical in all 48 cells (the same generated topology shape; types: pynqFpga 8, rpiCpu 32, xavierCpu 64, xavierDla 8, xavierGpu 8 on the servers)

utilisation.reading: Platform compute utilisation is about 0.9 % on the server platforms (the mean over the 120; the busiest platform is 8.5 % at the median over cells), and the busy time counts cold start + execution only. The no-queue latency is mostly data transfer (1.73 s of 1.93 s), which is not platform busy time; platform compute occupancy is therefore not what loads this cluster (descriptive; no mechanism claimed).
